lean.fidelity_note: `SDiv` is the period sum and `Lam5` is the entire displayed lower bound for $\log T(u)$. Substitution gives the printed identity with $c$, $L_a$ and $\ell_g$ represented by `C.cCount`, `D.La` and `D.lg`. The Lean lemma explicitly assumes $v>0$, $f>0$ and $w_{u_0,j}(\rho)>0$ for every lift and index $\rho$. It uses the lower-bound expression on its own, so it requires no hypothesis about the actual prime $T(u)$.
